ledger.x: 1575: Paulo Dias de Novais founds Luanda and the colony.
1582: the Portuguese found Massangano.
1602: Portugal founds the presidio of Cambambe.
1617: the Portuguese found Benguela.
1617: Governor Vasconcelos sacks Kabasa and drives Ngola Mbandi to Kindonga.
1622: peace; Nzinga returns to Kabasa in late 1622.
1626: the Portuguese install Hari a Kiluanji as king of Ndongo.
1641: the Dutch occupy Luanda.
1641: Nzinga, allied with the Dutch, reclaims 'large parts of Ndongo' (1641-1644); she routs a Portuguese army at Kombi in 1647.
1648 August: Luanda retaken.
1656: peace with Nzinga in late 1656; the 1657 treaty recognises her as queen of Ndongo and Matamba.
1671: the Portuguese-aligned Ndongo ends.
1671: Ndongo is annexed.
1683 September 7: Verónica I of Matamba accepts nominal vassalage.
1836: the nominal vassalage ends in conquest.
1836: Matamba passes to the colony.
1859: Pedro V of Kongo swears vassalage; Portugal builds a fort at São Salvador (garrison withdrawn 1866).
1885: Cabinda becomes a Portuguese protectorate.
1885 (bridge): the Kongo lands in Angola pass to the colony.
1890: Viye is annexed.
1910: Kasanje is incorporated.
1912: the Portuguese complete the occupation of the north-east.
ledger.cp: Chokwe and Lunda chiefdoms of the north-east (no dossier)

ledger.x: 1914: Portugal abolishes the Kongo monarchy 'following the Portuguese suppression of a Kongo revolt'.
1914: the last Kongo land passes to the colony.
1915: the Portuguese defeat the Cuanhama.
1920s: the Cabinda protectorate is incorporated into the colony.
1920s: effective occupation is completed.
1951: Angola becomes an overseas province of Portugal under the Estado Novo.
1975 November 11: independence.

wars.name: Portuguese conquest of Ndongo (Vasconcelos to Filipe's revolt)
wars.outcome: From the ambush of 1579-1580 and Massangano (1582) through the sack of Kabasa (1617) to the fall of Filipe's fortress in 1671; 'The Kingdom of Ndongo submitted to the Portuguese Crown in 1671.'

wars.name: Nzinga's wars against Portugal and the Dutch occupation of Luanda
wars.outcome: The Dutch held Luanda 1641-1648; Nzinga reclaimed large parts of Ndongo (1641-1644) and routed the Portuguese at Kombi (1647); peace in late 1656.

wars.name: Battle of Mbwila
wars.outcome: Portugal defeated Kongo on 29 October 1665 and obtained an act of vassalage from D.

certainty.note: A string of coastal and river settlements; the frontier with Ndongo was 'formalized' in 1599 (Ndongo page) but the pages (re-read in the fix pass) give no line.

Limits were fixed by agreements with the Congo Free State, Germany and France (1885-1886), the Anglo-Portuguese Treaty of 1891 and the 1905 award (Portuguese Angola page), but 'effective occupation ... only by the 1920s', so the lines were…
Treaty-fixed boundaries of the whole colony after the 1920s occupation; the pages name the treaties but not the lines.
